incident-bot: Pager triggered for model-quality-regression: service=llm-inference, model=redwood-alpha-v2, region=eu-west1. Signal: drop in quality metric and increase in hallucination rate. root_ts=2387654321
Dylan: I'm on pager, grabbing logs now. anyone see canary vs prod split?
Sara: I'll take primary. checking canary cohorts and rollout history.
James: seeing a 12% uptick in flagged hallucinations on eval set. Canary deploy finished ~03:58 UTC. Might be a bad tokenizer/weight mismatch, but run full diffs.
Maria: product: which customers are affected? Any high-revenue routes using eu-west1? need to prep comms.
Rachel: grabbing top 10 failing requests from the incident sampler, will paste examples in a sec.
Rachel: ```
Prompt: "Summarize the following legal excerpt..."
redwood-alpha-v2 output: "Incorrect statute number and invented precedent XYZ."
redwood-alpha-v1 output: "Summary with correct statute references and citations."
```
James: quick mitigation proposal: pin region to previous stable model. routing command (internal):
```
# pin eu-west1 to v1 (force 100% traffic)
platform route set --model redwood-alpha-v1 --region eu-west1 --weight 100 --reason "rollback-quality-regression-2387654321"
```
Sara: starting rollback to redwood-alpha-v1 in eu-west1 now. I'll watch the eval regressions and live error rate. ETA ~12-15m.
incident-bot: Rollback initiated by Sara at 04:25 UTC (2387654350). Traffic reconfiguration in progress.
Dylan: please draft status page update and short customer-facing note. Keep it concise: what happened, mitigation, ETA for root cause.
Maria: here's a short customer note draft — use for high-impact customers and status page: 
```
Subject: Incident: Temporary quality degradation for model redwood-alpha-v2 (eu-west1)
Body: Hi — we detected a quality regression affecting responses from model redwood-alpha-v2 in eu-west1. We've routed traffic to a stable model variant (redwood-alpha-v1) to restore expected behavior. No action required on your side. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with an update within 2 hours.
```
Sara: status page snippet (for ops/status API):
```json
{ "status": "degraded_performance", "component": "inference.eu-west1.redwood-alpha-v2", "message": "Quality regression detected; traffic routed to fallback model redwood-alpha-v1; mitigation in place" }
```
Dylan: internal comm template for SRE -> Customer Ops if asked for more detail: 
- timeline of events
- mitigation performed (routing pin to v1, rollback ts)
- sample failing prompts and comparison outputs
- ETA for RCA and follow-up
Use lightweight bullet points.
James: ML note: collect model weights hash, tokenizer version, and commit id for v2 canary. Also dump KV cache warmup logs. I'll sync with model team. tagging @model-oncall.
ops-bot: Reminder: attach runbook and link to playbook: https://internal.playbooks/reduce-model-regressions
Sara: handoff: Dylan, I'm handing to you for the next 4 hours. Checklist completed: rollback done, top 10 failing examples posted, status page draft ready, customer email draft ready.
Dylan: taking handoff. I'll monitor error rate, sampling, and user reports. Will push final status page update when metrics stable for 10m. If anything changes, I'll escalate to James and Maria.
Maria: thanks team. I'll prep a short customer notification for enterprise customers with dedicated contacts. keep me looped for wording approvals.
Dylan: noted. quick ask: James, can you post a short summary of diffs and next steps for the RCA channel? we can include in the postmortem.
James: will post diffs in ~30m and open RCA ticket.
Sara: adding :thumbsup: and closing my active pager. tagging Dylan.
Dylan: acknowledged, will update thread with final status.
